brightness.description: Upper bound: brightness of the effect peaks, in percent.
brightness.label: Brightness (%)

brightness_floor.description: Lower bound: resting brightness between hits, in percent. 0 keeps each mode's built-in rest level.
brightness_floor.label: Brightness floor (%)

color_mode.description: Visualizer style applied to the lights: Smooth, Ambient, Flashing, Energetic or Bass (low-end thumps only).
color_mode.label: Color mode

discovery_source.description: Auto first tries Music Assistant's own Home Assistant provider (no extra credentials needed), then a direct Home Assistant connection if one was configured in the setup flow, and uses the LAN as fallback/gap-filler. 'Home Assistant provider' uses only that provider; 'Home Assistant (direct)' uses only the setup-flow connection (LAN fills IP gaps in both HA modes); LAN ignores Home Assistant entirely.
discovery_source.label: Discovery source

ha_token.description: Long-lived access token from Home Assistant (profile -> Security). Collected by the setup flow, stored encrypted, and used read-only to list LIFX devices, entities, areas and config entries. Only needed when Music Assistant's Home Assistant provider is not configured.
ha_token.label: Home Assistant long-lived access token

ha_url.description: Base URL of your Home Assistant instance, e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123. Collected by the setup flow and only needed when Music Assistant's Home Assistant provider is not configured - with that provider, no HA credentials are entered in this plugin at all.
ha_url.label: Home Assistant URL

latency_ms.description: Shift the visualizer render time to compensate for speaker or network latency.
latency_ms.label: Latency compensation (ms)

send_rate_hz.description: Rate limit for color updates sent to each individual LIFX light.
send_rate_hz.label: Max sends per second (per light)

debug_frame_log.label: Debug frame log
debug_frame_log.description: Log one FRAMELOG line per second per streaming target with the mean/max brightness actually commanded to the lights (plus the Bass-mode band level). For diagnosing sync behavior from the server log; leave off in normal use.

manifest.description: Sync LIFX lights to music using the Sendspin visualizer: each Home Assistant area (or single matrix/ceiling light) becomes a virtual LIGHT player that reacts to the music in real time.

user.title: Direct Home Assistant connection (optional)
user.description: If Music Assistant's Home Assistant provider is configured, leave both fields empty - discovery borrows its connection. Only enter a Home Assistant URL and long-lived access token to use a direct connection instead. The token is stored encrypted. On reconfigure, leave the token empty to keep the previously stored one.

errors.ha_url_required: Enter the Home Assistant URL, or clear the token to skip the direct connection.
errors.ha_token_required: Enter a long-lived access token, or clear the URL to skip the direct connection.
errors.ha_connection_failed: Could not connect to Home Assistant with these details. Check the URL and token and try again.
